readyWork.summary: Audit historical equities, ETFs, rates, FX and futures sources for overlooked cross-market relationships.
deliverables: Source readiness inventory with provenance, availability, cost and gaps
At most three distinct mechanisms and one preregisterable experiment or blocker
Evidence-linked candidate result and handoff within the experiment budget
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar alignment, delistings, corporate actions, futures rolls, vintage releases, licensing and target-native execution evidence.
Use existing data only; do not open sealed outcomes
Record biases and remain DATA_FEASIBILITY or DATA_BLOCKED; no predictive promotion
Compare overlapping prior candidates and preserve their locked outcomes

readyWork.summary: Audit whether eligibility, proration, deadlines, amendments, cancellation and broker processing requirements can be reconstructed from existing public historical sources.
deliverables: Candidate-owned source audit and transfer assessment with citations
One preregisterable bounded successor or documented blocker
acceptanceCriteria: Source coverage and provenance document Eligibility, proration, deadlines, amendments, cancellation and broker processing requirements.
Define a historical event universe including failed/cancelled or nonrecovering cases and ordinary comparison periods; avoid selecting only famous winners.
Assess point-in-time prices/quotes, licensing, access, financing, execution costs, capacity and independent sample availability without opening outcome data.
Separate documented facts, practitioner performance claims and inferred mechanisms; include counterevidence and overlapping failed Marketlab candidates.
Register one successor with causal sources, sign, target/horizon, baseline, sample/exposure boundary, trial family and economic rejection threshold, or document a specific blocker.
Remain DATA_FEASIBILITY or DATA_BLOCKED; no sealed outcomes, predictive evaluation or successor acquisition in this audit.
